content: The main objective of the proposed system is to interact with students at the beginning of every conversation and gather information on the topic (and sub-topic), examination mode and level, question number and exact problem formulation. Therefore, the system saves time for tutors and allows them to handle solely complex mathematical questions. Besides that, the system is implemented in a way such that it accumulates labeled dialogues in the background and stores them in a structured form.
